owner_definition: Named human roles in a fictional local project; not external approval signatures.

entries.condition: Supported paraphrases may not match lexical cards.
entries.mitigation: Retain synonym miss and require versioned paired rewrite/date regressions.

entries.condition: A valid structured answer may use the wrong effective date.
entries.mitigation: Source approval, immutable intervals, bound candidate gate and scoped cache.
entries.residual: Human source authority and real-world policy correctness are not automated.

entries.condition: Guessed IDs or untrusted text could request another subject or a write.
entries.mitigation: Host identity, exact schema, own-order check, no HTTP write endpoint.
entries.residual: Public demo keys are not production identity.

entries.condition: A late result or misclassified cancellation may mislead users and metrics.
entries.mitigation: Locked terminal publication, worker-group stop, exception-order regression.
entries.residual: Connection loss alone does not stop work; Windows termination is unsupported.

entries.condition: Slow or failing dependencies exhaust capacity.
entries.mitigation: Input/active/attempt/deadline/storage bounds, breaker, honest fallback and monitor.
entries.residual: No hostile public-network or sustained-capacity validation.

entries.condition: Restoring a pointer leaves in-flight work and cannot reverse incompatible state.
entries.mitigation: Preserve manifests/traces, account for old jobs, check new request after switch.
entries.residual: Configuration-only drill; executable and migration recovery require separate artifacts.

entries.condition: Biased or private reports may become unjustified labels or retained personal text.
entries.mitigation: Bounded categories, quarantine, explicit minimized regression, expiry and deletion.
entries.residual: No full production erasure workflow or causal quality estimate.

entries.condition: A correct result may still be hard to perceive or act on.
entries.mitigation: Bilingual associated labels, keyboard focus, status and citation checks; retain repaired order field defect.
entries.residual: Assistive-technology user testing and full conformance remain unverified.

entries.condition: An attractive score may conceal failed model selection or judge calibration.
entries.mitigation: Retain rejected candidates, separate task denominators and use independent expected outcomes.

entries.condition: Hashes may be mistaken for trust, licenses or portability.
entries.mitigation: Retain reviewed Skill bytes, manifests, installed dependency metadata and license-file evidence.
entries.residual: No signed publisher chain or new Linux validation; hashes do not restore artifacts.
